title: Jump Game VII
problemStatement: You are given a binary string s and two integers minJump and maxJump. Starting at index 0, determine whether it is possible to reach the last index. From index i, you may jump to any index j satisfying: i + minJump <= j <= min(i + maxJump, n - 1) s[j] == '0' Return true if the last index can be reached; otherwise return false.
input: Binary string s Integer minJump Integer maxJump
output: true if the last index is reachable, otherwise false.
